description.en: MUSE evaluates text-to-CAD generation of complex B-Rep assemblies via design specifications. It scores models on code validity, geometric correctness, and design-intent alignment using rubrics covering functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability. A VLM judge with human validation is used for scalable scoring.

evidence.snippet: To address this gap, we introduce MUSE, a Text-to-CAD benchmark focused on complex, editable boundary representation (B-Rep) assemblies.

claire_radar.motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced text-driven 3D generation, yet Text-to-CAD remains far from supporting industrial product design.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing CAD benchmarks focus on single-part geometric similarity, missing industrial requirements. MUSE provides a structured evaluation that measures practical design quality, enabling progress toward engineering-ready CAD generation.
